name: fd-type-union
prompt: Bug: combining --type executable (or --type empty) with another --type drops results. The documentation says repeated --type values combine as a union, but `fd --type executable --type symlink` only lists executables: symlinks that are not executable are filtered out, and `--type empty --type symlink` loses symlinks the same way. Expected: each modifier applies only to what it describes (executable to regular files, empty to files and directories), and the other requested types are still listed.
